hints.content: On a  number line, numbers to the right are greater than numbers to the left.
The values of $\blueD{0}$, $\green{1}$,   and  $\maroonD{1\dfrac14}$  are to the right of  $\redD{-\dfrac14}$.
The values that make the inequality true are $\blueD{0}$, $\green{1}$,   and  $\maroonD{1\dfrac14}$.
